title: QHX's Requisites Reimagined
description: A modpack that adds new QoL features while preserving the original gameplay experience! Now on Modrinth!
body:
![The Requisites Reimagined Logo.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ddd2c7d04968a575d188bd936c29581aed91fe90.png)

# Now more optimized than ever, and on Modrinth!

**This modpack aims to add more quality-of-life features to Minecraft version 1.20.1.**

This modpack adds new player and entity animations with the **Fresh Animations resource pack**! Now your pets can look extra fabulous!

 

You can get immersed in the game with the realistic ambient sounds, thanks to the **AmbientSounds mod**! Complete with birds chirping, ocean waves, and much more, this mod is sure to immerse you!

 

And of course, we can't forget about the **Essential mod**! This mod adds QoL features including, but not limited to: joining friends' worlds without the need for a server, an in-game screenshot manager, and much more!


### So what are you waiting for? Install this modpack now for these exciting features and more!

## Additional Notes
- You are welcome to enable/disable any resource/shader pack you want. I highly discourage you from disabling any mods, as many of the mods work together to function.
- This modpack is the official reimagining and port of QHX's Requisites to Modrinth.
